protocol.ranking: Primary and variant queries were requested on both revisions. Panel metrics use the declared subset of full-run rankings. A separate HTTP panel repeat, when present, must return every ranking identically.
protocol.judgments: Strong combines exact rules and assistant-reviewed windows. Semantic silver uses incomplete category rules. Unjudged results give no ranking gain.
protocol.metrics: Query macro means. nDCG uses exponential gain; known recall counts all graded positives. MRR and success apply only to known items. Judged@10 is the judged fraction of returned documents on positive, nonempty rankings.
protocol.scope: Mailbox, unknown ID and as-of violations are counted across all returned top-10 IDs. The separate requested receipt window counts undated and out-of-window hits, on positives and verified empties.
protocol.uncertainty: Paired percentile cluster bootstrap, 10,000 draws, seed 2026. Resample family_id with all eligible queries; no variant enters primary. A separate positive-query interval groups by publisher validation_group. One owner yields no between-owner interval; few mailbox groups give descriptive intervals only.
protocol.snapshot: Candidate reports server SHA-256; legacy HTTP exposes mailbox counts. Per-server provenance records additional local source/corpus verification and sampled original HTTP bodies when available.
